thread:
Ravi (Hiring Manager): Heads up — candidate for L4 Product Designer asked for a later start (2026-06-01) due to relocation timing but wants benefits eligibility on 2026-05-01 if possible. Can benefits be front-loaded?
Priya (People Ops): Generally benefits eligibility starts on the paid start date. Any exception needs finance + benefits sign-off and a clear business rationale. Why the exception?
Ravi (Hiring Manager): Candidate is giving up early access to employer contributions at current job and asked if we can bridge for one month to avoid gap in health coverage. They proposed paying benefits from 2026-05-01 and issuing a pro-rated salary for the pre-start month.
Sofia (Comp & Ben): If we make them an employee earlier for benefits that affects headcount and pro-rate payroll. Also tax implications. Need a case and finance approval.
Maya (Benefits): We can allow benefits enrollment effective 2026-05-01 if they are on payroll by that date. If unpaid pre-start, we can still provide limited enrollment (e.g., allow benefits enrollment but medical coverage effective on paid start) — but bridging coverage requires them to be active employee and payroll processed.
people-ops-bot: created special-case PR-6107 for benefits-frontload request and pinged finance.
Priya (People Ops): Ravi, do you have budget to cover a one-month pro-rated salary? Which cost center?
Ravi (Hiring Manager): Charge ENG-PROD-11. We have small buffer in the bucket.
Sofia (Comp & Ben): Please upload rationale and any evidence of coverage gap (candidate note). If finance ok, comp can sign-off and we'll apply normal onboarding rules plus a note in offer.
Ravi (Hiring Manager): Uploaded candidate note and approved budget confirmation.
people-ops-bot: comp-committee notified.
Maya (Benefits): Confirming if payroll processes by 2026-05-01 benefits will be effective. Benefits team can fast-track enrollment after payroll confirmation.
Priya (People Ops): Finance please confirm whether ENG-PROD-11 can be charged for a pro-rated salary month and if any tax reporting changes required.
people-ops-bot: finance pinged; reminder in 6 hours.
Priya (People Ops): Update: Finance approved charging ENG-PROD-11 for one-month pro-rated payment. Comp & Ben approved sign-off. Benefits to fast-track enrollment. Offer updated to reflect paid start 2026-05-01 and relocation start 2026-06-01 but candidate will be on payroll from 2026-05-01. Note in offer about relocation reimbursement schedule.
Ravi (Hiring Manager): Sending offer now. Candidate accepted. :party_popper: Closing thread.
